runtimes.vm: Windows 11 ARM virtual machine (MIRRORZ Engine, Hypervisor.framework) with x64 apps via Microsoft Prism emulation
runtimes.bottle: MIRRORZ Bottle (Wine-based compatibility layer with DirectX-to-Metal translation, no Windows license needed)
runtimes.either: Both runtimes work; MIRRORZ picks Bottle first for speed and falls back to VM

apps.name: AutoCAD
apps.notes: Runs via Prism x64 emulation in Windows 11 ARM. Autodesk does not certify VMs or ARM. Use the CAD graphics preset.

fixups.reason: Autodesk installer components require Rosetta 2 on the host (Autodesk KB Error 10)
Installer fails when Downloads is mapped to macOS (Autodesk KB)
Fixes cursor lag / choppy linework: scaled resolution, mouse optimized for precision apps, GRAPHICSCONFIG tuned
Autodesk KB suggests disabling dynamic input if cursor lags

apps.name: AutoCAD LT
apps.notes: Same profile as AutoCAD; lighter.

apps.name: AutoCAD Architecture / MEP / Electrical / Mechanical / Map 3D / Plant 3D / Raster Design
apps.notes: Toolsets have no Mac version at all. Heavier installers; allow 40 GB.

apps.name: Civil 3D
apps.notes: Works for drafting-scale datasets; large corridors/surfaces are CPU-bound under emulation. 32 GB host recommended.

apps.name: Revit
apps.notes: No Mac version exists; this is the #1 reason architects buy Windows-on-Mac. Needs DX11 and lots of RAM; model size is the limiter.

fixups.reason: Revit is single-thread heavy under emulation; leave one core for macOS

apps.name: Inventor
apps.notes: Works for small/medium assemblies; DX11 required.

apps.name: Navisworks Manage / Simulate / Freedom
apps.notes: Freedom viewer is a great free test. Large NWDs are fine.

apps.name: Autodesk Fusion (Windows build)
apps.notes: Prefer the native macOS build. If you must use the Windows build in a VM, it crashes on Windows-on-ARM unless the software renderer is forced (Autodesk KB).

fixups.reason: Autodesk KB: Fusion crashes on startup on Windows on ARM / Parallels without this

apps.name: Autodesk Desktop Connector
apps.notes: Autodesk states Windows on ARM is not supported. Use the web Docs UI or host-side sync instead.

apps.name: SOLIDWORKS
apps.notes: Installs and runs under Prism; RealView/large assemblies are slow. Requires OpenGL 4.x in guest; graphics driver must expose it.

apps.name: SketchUp Pro (Windows) + Enscape/V-Ray
apps.notes: Native Mac SketchUp exists; the VM path is for Windows-only plugins such as Enscape (which needs DX12/ray tracing and will not run).

apps.name: Chief Architect Premier
apps.notes: Native Mac build exists; Windows build works in VM for parity with Windows-only features.

apps.name: Vectorworks
apps.notes: Use the native Mac version.

apps.name: Archicad
apps.notes: Use the native Mac version.

apps.name: ArcGIS Pro
apps.notes: Runs via Prism; DX11 required; heavy rasters are slow.

apps.name: Microsoft Office (Windows build: Access, Visio, Project, VBA parity)
apps.notes: Office ships ARM64-native, so it is fast in the VM. In a Bottle, Office 2016/2019/365 installs work with the office preset; Access and Visio have no Mac versions.

apps.name: QuickBooks Desktop (Pro/Premier/Enterprise)
apps.notes: Top request from accountants. Works in VM. Multi-user/hosting mode needs stable virtual network identity.

fixups.reason: Intuit licensing binds to hardware identity

apps.name: Sage 50 (US/UK)
apps.notes: Works in VM; needs Pervasive/Actian engine (x64) which runs under Prism.

apps.name: MATLAB (Windows toolboxes)
apps.notes: Native Apple Silicon MATLAB exists; VM only for Windows-only toolboxes/Simulink targets.

apps.name: Altium Designer
apps.notes: DX11 required; 3D PCB view is slow but usable.

apps.name: EPLAN Electric P8
apps.notes: Runs; dongle/licensing may require USB passthrough.

apps.name: Steam games (DirectX 11)
apps.notes: Bottle with D3D-to-Metal translation is far faster than a VM for games. Anti-cheat (EAC/BattlEye kernel drivers) blocks many multiplayer titles.

apps.name: Steam games (DirectX 12)
apps.notes: DX12 translation is newer; expect a per-title matrix.

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.notes: Instant in a Bottle; also ARM64-native in the VM.

apps.name: Edge with IE mode / legacy ActiveX portals
apps.notes: ARM64-native Edge in the VM; the only way to reach legacy ActiveX line-of-business portals.

apps.name: Line-of-business .NET Framework apps (generic)
apps.notes: Bottle handles most WinForms/WPF via bundled .NET runtimes; fall back to VM for apps that need services, drivers or Windows Authentication.

apps.name: Visual Studio 2022 (ARM64)
apps.notes: ARM64-native VS 2022 in the VM is fast. Use the Pro plan CLI to script VM lifecycle.

apps.name: SQL Server 2022 Developer
apps.notes: Installs under Prism; SQL Server has no ARM64 build. Use Docker on the host for Linux SQL Server if possible.

apps.name: Adobe apps (Windows-only plugins/versions)
apps.notes: Use native Mac Creative Cloud. Adobe licensing dislikes changing hardware IDs.

apps.name: Misc. Win32 utilities (installers, tools, drivers UIs)
apps.notes: Default landing runtime for unknown .exe files; MIRRORZ escalates to VM if the Bottle fails to launch.

office.description: Office/LOB apps: crisp text, shared clipboard, printers
